dc3b83cc8f0dedcf.description: About Red Sea Global Red Sea Global (RSG) is a purpose-driven developer focused on positively shaping the places where people live, work, and travel. The company's programs contribute to achieving Vision 2030 and advancing regenerative tourism globally. RSG is seeking a Social Media Manager to join its team in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. Role Purpose The Social Media Manager is responsible for the daily execution of the social media function. This involves translating the approved social media strategy into integrated content plans, campaigns, and channel activities. The role requires coordinating with internal teams, stakeholders, agencies, and other Red Sea Studios divisions to produce aligned, platform-appropriate content, ensure brand and governance standards are met, enhance audience engagement, and provide performance insights to the Social Media Associate Director. Key Responsibilities Translate social media strategy and annual priorities into channel plans, editorial calendars, campaign workplans, and team assignments. Manage daily team workload, priorities, quality, and deadlines, providing coaching and guidance to social media specialists. Oversee the end-to-end content workflow, including briefs, production coordination, reviews, approvals, publishing, optimization, and archiving. Collaborate with Production & Filming, Art & Animation, Visualization, and other Red Sea Studios divisions for coordinated content development. Ensure organic and paid content adheres to approved brand identity, tone of voice, accessibility, quality, and approval requirements. Coordinate campaign launches, events, live coverage, and always-on content across relevant social platforms. Oversee community management, ensuring comments, messages, and stakeholder inquiries are handled according to approved protocols. Monitor emerging issues, audience sentiment, and platform conversations, escalating timely with relevant stakeholders. Track channel and campaign KPIs, including reach, engagement, audience growth, sentiment, traffic, conversions, and content performance. Prepare regular performance reports and convert insights into practical recommendations for content, channel, and campaign optimization. Manage day-to-day agency, influencer, media, and vendor deliverables, ensuring scope, quality, timelines, and approved budgets are controlled. Maintain accurate records for content approvals, publishing, contracts, purchase requests, invoices, and performance documentation. Follow relevant functional policies, processes, and procedures to ensure controlled and consistent work execution. Contribute to identifying opportunities for continuous improvement in departmental systems, processes, and practices. Qualifications and Experience 5-10 years of experience in social media management. Demonstrated ability to translate strategy into actionable content plans and campaigns. Experience in managing content workflows from brief to publishing. Proficiency in tracking KPIs and generating performance reports with actionable insights. Experience coordinating with multiple stakeholders and external agencies. Work Environment This full-time role operates in a dynamic, highly visible environment with multiple concurrent campaigns and stakeholder requests. The position requires balancing planned delivery with real-time publishing, community issues, and urgent business priorities. Flexibility may be required outside normal working hours for launches, events, live coverage, or urgent matters.

dcabaf92c9a707bd.description: About the Role Johnson Controls Arabia is seeking a Sales Representative, HVAC & Refrigeration, to join our team in Jeddah, Makkah, Saudi Arabia. This full-time role focuses on promoting and selling HVAC and refrigeration spare parts, accessories, and commercial refrigeration units. The position requires 2-5 years of relevant experience. Key Responsibilities Develop new business opportunities and acquire customers for HVAC and refrigeration products. Promote and sell HVAC accessories and refrigeration products, including commercial refrigeration units. Maintain strong relationships with existing customers to ensure continued satisfaction and sales. Prepare accurate quotations and negotiate sales agreements with clients. Achieve assigned sales targets within the designated territory. Conduct regular customer visits and follow up on orders to ensure timely delivery and client satisfaction. Qualifications and Requirements Bachelor’s degree in Business or Engineering. 3–5 years of sales experience specifically in HVAC accessories and refrigeration. Good knowledge of HVAC and refrigeration spare parts and accessories. Demonstrated experience in selling commercial refrigeration units. Strong communication and negotiation skills are essential for client interaction and sales closures. A valid Saudi driving license is preferred for this role, which involves customer visits. Work Environment This is a full-time position based in Jeddah, Makkah, Saudi Arabia, requiring regular interaction with clients and internal teams. Application Process Candidates who meet the specified qualifications are encouraged to apply for this role.

dc72848b068aa38e.description: Who Are We❓ We Are Foodics! a leading restaurant management ecosystem and payment tech provider. Founded in 2014 with headquarters in Riyadh and offices across 5 countries, including UAE, Egypt, Jordan and Kuwait. We are currently serving customers and partners in over 35 different countries worldwide. Our innovative products have successfully processed over 6 billion (yes, billion with a B) orders so far! making Foodics one of the most rapidly evolving SaaS companies to ever emerge from the MENA region. Also, Foodics has achieved three rounds of funding, with the latest raising $170 million in the largest SaaS funding round in MENA, boosting its innovation capabilities to better serve business owners. The Job in a Nutshell💡 The Sales Expansion Team Leader manages an outbound sales team focused on driving revenue growth from existing clients. This role is responsible for directing lead generation within the current customer base, coaching representatives to cross-sell and upsell new product lines, and executing strategies that directly increase Average Revenue Per User (ARPU). Main Task & Responsibilities 💡 Expansion Sales Management: Handle incoming new branch sales requests from existing customers. Generate and send quotes promptly, ensuring accuracy and alignment with customer needs. Track expansion requests and ensure timely follow-ups to close deals efficiently. Upselling & Cross-Selling Focus: Identifying new upselling & cross-selling opportunities from existing customers through outbound activities. Identify and recommend additional products to maximize revenue from expansion deals. Ensure that every expansion quote includes relevant upsell/cross-sell products before sending to the customer. Sales Process & Coordination: Work closely with internal teams to ensure smooth processing of expansion sales. Communicate effectively with customers regarding their expansion needs and available solutions. Maintain accurate records of expansion requests in the CRM system. What Are We Looking For❓ Experience: 3–5 years of experience in sales, account management, or a related field, with at least 2 years of experience leading a team. Experience in handling sales requests and generating quotes. Experience working with CRM systems to manage and track sales activities. Skills: Strong sales mindset with a focus on upselling and cross-selling. Excellent communication and negotiation skills. Detail-oriented with strong organizational abilities. Ability to work efficiently under pressure and meet deadlines. Experience in SaaS or technology sales is an advantage. Knowledge of Foodics products and their value to different business models. What We Offer You❗ We believe you will love working at Foodics! We offer highly competitive compensation packages, including bonuses and the potential for shares. We prioritize personal development and offer regular training and an annual learning stipend to tackle new challenges and grow your career in a hyper-growth environment. Join a talented team of over 30 nationalities working in 14 countries, and gain valuable experience in an exciting industry. We offer autonomy, mentoring, and challenging goals that create incredible opportunities for both you and the company.

dc778ddc6a8a26c3.description: Location: BOUNCE Venue - Solitare Mall Reporting To: Venue Manager Job Summary We are looking for an enthusiastic and motivated Team Leader to oversee daily venue operations, lead and support the team, and ensure an exceptional customer experience while maintaining high standards of service, quality, and safety. Key Responsibilities Supervise and lead team members, assign tasks, and monitor daily performance. Ensure excellent customer service and handle customer inquiries and complaints effectively. Coordinate group bookings, birthday parties, and venue activities. Oversee trampoline areas, reception, café, and party areas to ensure smooth operations. Ensure compliance with safety procedures and injury prevention standards. Train, coach, and motivate team members to improve performance. Maintain cleanliness, organization, and overall venue presentation. Monitor stock levels, sales, and daily cash handling procedures. Ensure regular maintenance and readiness of equipment and facilities. Coordinate with the Venue Manager to ensure efficient daily operations. Required Skills Strong leadership and team management skills. Excellent communication and customer service skills. Problem-solving and decision-making abilities. Ability to work in a fast-paced environment. Strong organizational and time management skills. Ability to multitask and work under pressure. High commitment to safety and service quality.
dc778ddc6a8a26c3.industry: Entertainment & Tourism, Personal Care & Gyms, F&B

dc653cb88ff49ba4.description: About Le Meridien Le Meridien, part of the Marriott International portfolio of brands, is inspired by the era of glamorous travel, celebrating each culture through a distinctly European spirit. The brand focuses on providing authentic, chic, and memorable service along with experiences that inspire guests to savor the good life. We seek curious and creative individuals who appreciate connecting with like-minded guests and have a deep desire to create memorable experiences. Role Summary The Cashier-Food & Beverage Svcs processes all payment methods in accordance with established accounting procedures and policies. This full-time position requires adherence to property control audit standards and cash handling procedures, ensuring accuracy and security of all transactions. The role involves managing a bank, processing payments, and maintaining a clean and organized workstation. Key Responsibilities Process all payment methods in accordance with Accounting procedures and policies. Follow property control audit standards and cash handling procedures, including blind drops. Obtain assigned bank, ensure accuracy of contracted monies, and secure the bank at all times. Count the bank at the end of the shift, complete designated cashier reports, and resolve discrepancies. Set up and organize the cashier workstation with designated supplies, forms, and resource materials, maintaining cleanliness. Complete opening duties, including setting up necessary supplies and tools, and ensuring everything is in working order. Welcome and acknowledge all guests according to company standards, anticipate service needs, and thank guests. Speak with others using clear and professional language, and answer telephones using appropriate etiquette. Enter and locate work-related information using computers and/or point of sale systems. Qualifications and Requirements Experience required: 0-1 year in a related field. Ability to follow all company safety and security policies and procedures. Maintain a clean and professional uniform and personal appearance. Ability to maintain confidentiality of proprietary information and protect company assets. Capacity to develop and maintain positive working relationships with colleagues and support team goals. Adherence to quality expectations and standards. Ability to stand, sit, or walk for extended periods. Ability to move, lift, carry, push, pull, and place objects weighing less than or equal to 10 pounds without assistance. Work Environment and Culture Le Meridien fosters an environment where the unique backgrounds of associates are valued and celebrated. The company is committed to non-discrimination on any protected basis, including disability or veteran status. Associates are encouraged to do their best work, pursue their purpose, and belong to a global team within Marriott International. Application Process We invite interested candidates to explore career opportunities with Le Meridien and join a team dedicated to creating memorable experiences for guests.

dc5b433e0fcfa567.description: About the Role Swissport KSA is seeking a QHSE Officer to join their team in Dammam, Eastern, Saudi Arabia. This full-time role involves monitoring, implementing, and maintaining Quality, Health, Safety, and Environmental standards across Swissport's airport ground handling operations. The position requires 2-5 years of experience and focuses on ensuring compliance with corporate QHSE policies, Saudi Arabian regulations, GACA requirements, and international aviation safety standards. Key Responsibilities Monitor compliance with Swissport safety policies, operational procedures, and airport safety regulations. Conduct regular safety inspections across various operational areas including ramp, passenger services, baggage handling, and cargo. Identify unsafe acts, hazardous conditions, and operational risks, recommending corrective actions. Support the implementation and continuous improvement of the Safety Management System (SMS). Ensure compliance with GACA requirements, airport authority regulations, and Swissport Global Standards. Conduct scheduled and unannounced operational inspections and quality checks. Support internal and external audits, including airline customer audits and regulatory inspections. Participate in investigations of incidents such as aircraft damage, ground support equipment incidents, and employee injuries. Collect evidence, interview personnel, and prepare investigation reports, supporting root cause analysis. Monitor occupational health and workplace safety practices, identifying potential health and environmental hazards. Support emergency response preparedness, evacuation drills, and safety exercises. Conduct safety briefings, toolbox talks, and awareness campaigns, identifying safety training needs. Prepare daily, weekly, and monthly QHSE inspection and performance reports. Maintain accurate records of safety observations, incidents, investigations, audits, and corrective actions. Authority and Accountability The QHSE Officer is authorized to report unsafe practices and non-compliance directly to QHSE management and recommend immediate suspension of unsafe activities where company procedures allow. This role involves requesting corrective actions from responsible operational departments and escalating serious safety risks, incidents, and repeated violations to management. The officer is accountable for the accuracy of QHSE reporting, timely escalation of significant risks, and professional performance of assigned duties. Qualifications and Experience 2-5 years of relevant experience in Quality, Health, Safety, and Environmental roles. Understanding of Swissport's corporate QHSE policies and operational procedures. Knowledge of applicable Saudi Arabian regulations and General Authority of Civil Aviation (GACA) requirements. Familiarity with international aviation safety standards, IATA Ground Operations Manual (IGOM), and ISAGO standards. Ability to conduct inspections, investigations, and risk assessments. Proficiency in preparing detailed reports and maintaining accurate documentation. Work Environment This is a full-time position based in Dammam, Eastern, Saudi Arabia, within Swissport's airport ground handling operations. The role requires active engagement across various operational areas, promoting a proactive safety culture and ensuring compliance in a dynamic aviation environment.

dca5c7bc6f76c7c1.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة الخليج للتموين عن مشرف إنتاج للانضمام إلى فريقها في الرياض، وتحديداً في وادي الدواسر. يهدف هذا الدور بدوام كامل إلى ضمان تحقيق مستويات عالية من رضا العملاء من خلال الإشراف على عمليات خدمات الطعام، مع الالتزام بمعايير التغذية والسلامة والجودة. يتطلب الدور خبرة تتراوح بين 2 و5 سنوات في مجال ذي صلة. الهدف الرئيسي للدور يتمثل الهدف الأساسي لمشرف الإنتاج في الإشراف على جميع جوانب تقديم خدمات الطعام لضمان التوافق التام مع معايير التغذية، السلامة، والجودة المحددة. يشمل ذلك مراقبة العمليات اليومية وتقديم الإرشاد اللازم للحفاظ على جودة الخدمة ورضا العملاء. المهام والمسؤوليات تقديم الإرشاد الغذائي في المستشفى بما يتماشى مع توجيهات الشركة وقسم التغذية. الإشراف على تدريب العمال المسؤولين عن تقديم الوجبات الجاهزة. الإشراف الكامل على توزيع الوجبات الجاهزة وترتيب الأصناف الغذائية في صينية المريض وفي صالة الطعام. توجيه العاملين في إعداد وتقديم الوجبات الجاهزة. الالتزام بقواعد وأنظمة الصحة والسلامة المهنية للعميل. استخدام معدات الوقاية الشخصية الصحيحة والحفاظ عليها في حالة جيدة. إجراء عمليات تفتيش يومية لجميع المناطق لضمان الحفاظ على معايير النظافة الممتازة. الإشراف على وجبات المرضى على خط توزيع الوجبات الجاهزة. المساهمة في تطوير العمل والوجبات وتقديم المقترحات والحلول لمدير الموقع. التنسيق مع رئيس الطهاة فيما يتعلق بإعداد الوجبات الجاهزة وطريقة التقطيع والعرض المناسب. مقابلة مستحقي التغذية لمعرفة آرائهم حول الطريقة المناسبة لتقديم الوجبة، بالإضافة إلى العمل على برنامج التقييم المتاح من الشركة. المؤهلات والخبرات المطلوبة خبرة عملية تتراوح بين 2 إلى 5 سنوات في مجال الإشراف على الإنتاج أو خدمات الطعام. فهم قوي لمعايير التغذية والسلامة والجودة في قطاع الأغذية. القدرة على تدريب وتوجيه فرق العمل بفعالية. بيئة العمل يعمل مشرف الإنتاج في بيئة ديناميكية تتطلب الإشراف المباشر على عمليات تقديم الطعام في المواقع المحددة. يتطلب الدور التنسيق المستمر مع فرق العمل والإدارة لضمان سير العمل بسلاسة وفعالية. معلومات إضافية هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل في وادي الدواسر، الرياض. لم يتم الكشف عن تفاصيل الراتب في الوقت الحالي.

dca6a021ebca0b0c.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث كلية بيت البترجي للعلوم الطبية والتكنولوجيا عن فني أجهزة طبية للانضمام إلى فريقها في جدة، مكة المكرمة. يركز هذا الدور بدوام كامل على متابعة تركيب الأجهزة الطبية وتشغيلها، بالإضافة إلى تنفيذ برامج الصيانة الوقائية والعلاجية لضمان كفاءة الأداء. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية متابعة مخططات تركيب الأجهزة الطبية المتنوعة، مثل أجهزة غسل الكلى، وأجهزة دعم القلب والتنفس والرئة، وأجهزة التصوير والتخطيط الطبي. تحديد مواقع التركيب ومتابعة إجراءات التثبيت، وإعداد قوائم بقطع الغيار الاحتياطية الضرورية. متابعة إجراءات التشغيل التجريبي للأجهزة الطبية والتأكد من تشغيلها وفقاً لأدلة التشغيل المعتمدة. تدريب مستخدمي الأجهزة الطبية على إجراءات التشغيل السليم والضبط الصحيح. تتبع مخططات الدارات الإلكترونية للأجهزة الطبية وتشخيص الأعطال باستخدام أجهزة الفحص والقياس، ثم تنفيذ إجراءات الإصلاح والضبط اللازمة. تنفيذ برامج الصيانة الوقائية للأجهزة الطبية حسب تعليمات الشركة المصنعة. إعداد وتقديم وتوثيق وحفظ تقارير العمل بشكل دوري. المؤهلات والخبرة خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى 1 سنة في مجال صيانة وتركيب الأجهزة الطبية. القدرة على فهم وتطبيق تعليمات الشركات المصنعة للأجهزة. المهارات المطلوبة مهارات فنية قوية في تشخيص وإصلاح الأعطال. القدرة على قراءة وتتبع المخططات الفنية والكهربائية. مهارات تواصل جيدة لتدريب المستخدمين وإعداد التقارير. الالتزام بمعايير السلامة والجودة في التعامل مع الأجهزة الطبية. بيئة العمل يعمل فني الأجهزة الطبية بدوام كامل ضمن فريق الكلية في مدينة جدة، مكة المكرمة. يتطلب الدور التفاعل المستمر مع الأجهزة الطبية المختلفة والموظفين لضمان سير العمل بكفاءة. معلومات إضافية الراتب الخاص بهذا الدور لم يتم الكشف عنه.

dcfd2233df3b6537.description: About the Role alfanar Group is seeking a Senior SAP SD Functional Consultant to join their team in Riyadh. This full-time position requires an experienced professional to assist project teams in configuring business processes within assigned SAP ERP modules, ensuring efficiency, timely delivery, and adherence to quality standards. Role Purpose and Scope The primary purpose of this role is to support departmental operational plans and developments by efficiently configuring business processes within assigned SAP ERP modules. The consultant will ensure that configurations meet defined policies, procedures, and quality standards, contributing to wider organizational objectives. Key Responsibilities Provide subject matter expertise on SAP's best practices for implementing respective SAP module business processes. Lead workshops to gather business requirements, promote the adoption of standard SAP processes, and identify and manage gaps while minimizing development effort. Design, configure, test, and implement assigned SAP module business processes, ensuring adherence to SAP standards and minimizing customization. Define and execute unit test, integration test, and regression test scripts to validate key end-to-end business scenarios. Troubleshoot complex functional issues and bugs identified during implementation, testing, and post-Go Live phases. Contribute to IT department level improvements by delivering on initiatives that enhance governance and standardization of processes, including Business Process & Procedures. Accountability Areas SAP Module Expertise and Business Process Improvement SAP Module Configuration and Testing Project Management and Documentation Support and Incident Resolution Delivery and Quality Assurance Problem-Solving and Compliance Qualifications and Experience A minimum of 6 to 10 years of experience in SAP SD functional consulting. Demonstrated proficiency in HR processes. Proven ability to foster innovation and build positive relationships with colleagues and customers. Work Environment This is a full-time position based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. The role involves working within a project team environment, contributing to IT department improvements and ensuring compliance with health, safety, and environmental standards.

dc596d499155896a.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث مؤسسة حامد سعود العتيبي للمقاولات عن أخصائي إدارة خدمات للانضمام إلى فريقها في عرعر، الحدود الشمالية. يتولى شاغل هذا الدور مسؤولية دراسة وتحليل الخدمات، وإعداد الخطط التطويرية والتشغيلية، بالإضافة إلى تحسين فعاليتها لضمان تقديم خدمات عالية الجودة. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية إعداد الوثائق والتقارير المتخصصة المتعلقة بإدارة الخدمات، وتقديم التوصيات والحلول المناسبة، وعرضها وحفظها في قاعدة البيانات المخصصة وفقاً للسياسات والإجراءات المعتمدة. دراسة التجارب والممارسات المتعلقة بإدارة الخدمات، وتقييم إمكانية وجدوى الاستفادة منها، ورفع التوصيات والمقترحات لتبني أفضل الأساليب والممارسات. إعداد الخطط التشغيلية للخدمات المختلفة بأكبر فعالية ممكنة، وتحليل العمليات والإجراءات التفصيلية، وضمان تكاملها وترابطها وسلامة مساراتها التدفقية لضمان تقديم الخدمات ضمن أعلى معايير الكفاءة والجودة. وضع الحلول المناسبة للمشاكل والتحديات التي قد تواجه إدارة الخدمات. تطوير أساليب وإجراءات التطوير الإداري باستخدام التقنيات الحديثة، ومواكبة التطورات والمستجدات في مجال إدارة الخدمات. المؤهلات والخبرات المطلوبة خبرة عملية تتراوح بين 2 إلى 5 سنوات في مجال إدارة الخدمات أو ما يعادلها. القدرة على دراسة وتحليل الخدمات وتحديد الاحتياجات التطويرية. مهارات ممتازة في إعداد التقارير والوثائق الفنية. بيئة العمل هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل في مدينة عرعر، الحدود الشمالية. يعمل أخصائي إدارة الخدمات ضمن فريق متخصص، ويسهم في تحسين وتطوير الخدمات المقدمة من قبل المؤسسة. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذه الوظيفة سيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات بعد المقابلة.

dc09edf97913ed8b.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة الكابلي للتسويق عن مندوب مبيعات للانضمام إلى فريقها في منطقة القصيم، بمدينة بريدة. هذا الدور مخصص للعمل بدوام كامل ويتطلب خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى سنة واحدة في مجال المبيعات. يهدف شاغل الوظيفة إلى تعزيز المبيعات وبناء علاقات قوية مع العملاء. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية بناء وتحديث قاعدة بيانات شاملة للعملاء الحاليين والمحتملين، تتضمن بياناتهم وعناوينهم وأرقام هواتفهم. التواصل مع العملاء وزيارتهم لترويج المنتجات والخدمات، وتقديم عروض البيع، مع استعراض مواصفاتها وميزاتها التنافسية. التحقق من الأسعار ومنح الخصومات ضمن الصلاحيات المحددة، وإتمام عمليات البيع وتحرير الفواتير وتحصيل المبالغ المستحقة. تحصيل ديون العملاء وتسجيلها وتوثيقها، ثم توريدها إلى الدائرة المالية. إعداد وتقديم تقارير العمل الدورية، وتوثيقها وحفظها بشكل منظم. المؤهلات والخبرات المطلوبة خبرة عملية تتراوح من 0 إلى سنة واحدة في مجال المبيعات. القدرة على بناء علاقات مهنية قوية مع العملاء. مهارات تواصل وعرض ممتازة. بيئة العمل هذا الدور هو وظيفة بدوام كامل ضمن فريق عمل شركة الكابلي للتسويق في مدينة بريدة، القصيم. يتطلب الدور التفاعل المباشر مع العملاء والعمل الميداني لترويج المنتجات وتحقيق أهداف المبيعات. معلومات إضافية الراتب الخاص بهذا الدور سيتم تحديده ومناقشته خلال المقابلة الشخصية. نشجع المتقدمين الذين يمتلكون الشغف بالمبيعات والقدرة على تحقيق الأهداف على التقديم.

dc10d9d2a4cb5d3c.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة الاتحاد الهندسي السعودية للاستشارات الهندسية خطيب وعلمي عن مهندس ميكانيكي للانضمام إلى فريقها في أبها، عسير. يتطلب هذا الدور خبرة تتراوح بين 2 و5 سنوات، ويشمل إعداد التصاميم والمخططات لمشاريع الهندسة الميكانيكية، بالإضافة إلى تطوير برامج التشغيل والصيانة للمعدات الصناعية. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية إعداد التصاميم والمخططات لمشاريع الهندسة الميكانيكية، بما في ذلك المولدات، التوربينات، وحدات التكييف، المراجل، وشبكات التوزيع لأنظمة التدفئة والتكييف والتبريد. تطوير خطط وبرامج تجميع وتركيب التجهيزات الميكانيكية للمشاريع الصناعية، وتحديد أنظمة الضبط والتحكم اللازمة. إعداد برامج تشغيل المعدات وبرامج الصيانة الوقائية، بالالتزام بتعليمات الشركات المصنعة ومتابعة إجراءات تنفيذها. تطوير أساليب وإجراءات العمل ومواكبة التطورات التقنية في مجال الهندسة الميكانيكية. إعداد الوثائق والتقارير المتخصصة المتعلقة بالأعمال والمشاريع الهندسية، وتوضيح نسب تقدمها وحفظها في قاعدة البيانات المخصصة وفقاً للسياسات والإجراءات المعتمدة. المؤهلات والخبرات المطلوبة خبرة عملية تتراوح بين 2 إلى 5 سنوات في مجال الهندسة الميكانيكية. القدرة على إعداد التصاميم والمخططات الهندسية بدقة. معرفة ببرامج تجميع وتركيب وتشغيل التجهيزات الميكانيكية. فهم جيد لبرامج الصيانة الوقائية للمعدات الصناعية. بيئة العمل هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل في مدينة أبها بمنطقة عسير. سيعمل المهندس الميكانيكي ضمن فريق متخصص في شركة استشارية هندسية رائدة، مما يوفر بيئة عمل داعمة للتطوير المهني. ملخص الدور يتولى المهندس الميكانيكي مسؤولية شاملة في تصميم وتطوير وتنفيذ الحلول الميكانيكية للمشاريع، مع التركيز على الكفاءة التشغيلية والصيانة الوقائية. الدور يتطلب دقة في العمل، والالتزام بالمعايير الهندسية، والقدرة على إعداد التقارير الفنية المتخصصة. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذه الوظيفة سيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات، وسيتم الإفصاح عنه خلال عملية التوظيف. هذه فرصة للانضمام إلى شركة رائدة في مجال الاستشارات الهندسية.

dc4f875a9d3b2cf9.description: About Delivery Hero SE Delivery Hero SE is a global leader in local delivery platforms, operating in approximately 65 countries worldwide. Headquartered in Berlin, Germany, the company has been listed on the Frankfurt Stock Exchange since 2017 and is part of the MDAX stock market index. Hungerstation, a part of the Delivery Hero Group, is dedicated to providing a fast, easy, and exceptional delivery experience directly to customers' doors. Role Overview Delivery Hero SE is seeking a Vendor Performance Senior Specialist to join its team in Riyadh. This full-time role focuses on enhancing vendor fulfillment performance and ensuring a seamless customer experience. The specialist will be responsible for monitoring key performance indicators, identifying areas for improvement, and implementing corrective actions to optimize delivery operations. Key Responsibilities Monitor daily, weekly, and monthly fulfillment performance across metrics such as replacement rate, Item Not Found (INF), Item Not Delivered (IND), order failure rate, and seamless orders. Identify trends and recurring issues, prioritize opportunities based on customer and business impact, and drive corrective actions to achieve measurable improvements. Reduce INF and IND by improving the accuracy and timeliness of vendor stock feeds and addressing discrepancies between ordered and delivered items, accounting for successful replacements. Optimize replacements by assessing the end-to-end replacement journey, including suggestion relevance, customer response windows, configurations, and vendor execution. Analyze order failure reasons across vendor, customer, and logistics ownership to identify root causes, trends, and recurring patterns, implementing both immediate recovery and long-term prevention measures. Increase seamless orders by investigating unsatisfactory orders (late, incomplete, incorrect, damaged, spilled) and related refunds, working with teams to address recurring causes. Act as the operational point of contact for vendor fulfillment issues, assessing impact, raising incident tickets, coordinating workarounds, and driving resolution with relevant teams. Adhere to all relevant policies, procedures, and processes to ensure consistent daily operations. Contribute to identifying opportunities for continuous improvement in processes, practices, cost-effectiveness, and productivity. Prepare timely and accurate reports to meet requirements, objectives, and standards. Ensure satisfaction for both internal and external stakeholders by addressing their needs promptly and courteously. Required Experience Candidates should possess 2-5 years of relevant professional experience. Work Environment This is a full-time position based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, offering an opportunity to contribute to a dynamic global delivery platform.

dc7e5da530933889.description: نبذة عن الدور تعلن شركة حامد عبدالغني الزبيدي للمقاولات عن حاجتها لتعيين سكرتير تنفيذي للانضمام إلى فريقها في الليث، مكة المكرمة. يهدف هذا الدور إلى تقديم الدعم الإداري والتنظيمي للمدير/الرئيس، مما يضمن سير العمليات اليومية بسلاسة وفعالية. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية تنظيم وإدارة مواعيد المدير/الرئيس وتذكيره بها بشكل مستمر. التعامل مع الاستفسارات الواردة والرد عليها، بالإضافة إلى استلام وتوصيل البريد والمراسلات للمدير/الرئيس. إعداد المذكرات الدورية المتعلقة بعمل الوحدات التنظيمية الداخلية في الشركة. إجراء المراسلات الاعتيادية مع الجهات الخارجية، والتأكد من توقيعها من المدير/الرئيس، ثم توزيعها. حضور الاجتماعات، وتسجيل محاضرها، والعمل على تحريرها وتوثيقها. حفظ وتنظيم جميع الوثائق والملفات المتعلقة بأعمال المدير/الرئيس. إعداد وتقديم تقارير العمل الدورية، وتوثيقها، وحفظها في الأرشيف المخصص. المؤهلات والخبرات المطلوبة خبرة عملية تتراوح بين 0 إلى 1 سنة في مجال السكرتارية التنفيذية أو ما يعادلها. القدرة على تنظيم المهام وتحديد الأولويات بفعالية. مهارات تواصل كتابية وشفوية ممتازة. نوع الوظيفة هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل، وتتطلب التفرغ التام لأداء المهام الموكلة. موقع العمل يقع مقر العمل في مدينة الليث، بمنطقة مكة المكرمة. معلومات إضافية الراتب سيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات بعد المقابلة الشخصية.

dc491ba6dda34e7b.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث الشركة العالميه لتسويق مستلزمات النوم عن أخصائي مبيعات للانضمام إلى فريقها في جدة، مكة المكرمة. يركز هذا الدور بدوام كامل على تطوير سياسات البيع، متابعة تنفيذها، وتقييم النتائج لضمان تحقيق الأهداف البيعية. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية دراسة ومتابعة تطورات السوق لتحديد وتطوير الأهداف التسويقية وطرق البيع. تقدير حجم المبيعات المتوقع وترجمة الأهداف إلى خطط بيعية قابلة للتنفيذ. اقتراح سياسات البيع ومتابعة تنفيذها، بالإضافة إلى وضع وتقييم البرامج الترويجية. التواصل الفعال مع الزبائن لتحديد مشكلاتهم ومتابعة المنافسين وبرامجهم البيعية لتجنب المخاطر المستقبلية. تقييم أداء مندوبي البيع ومدى تحقيق الأهداف البيعية، واقتراح الخطط والإجراءات التصحيحية اللازمة. إعداد الوثائق والتقارير المتخصصة المتعلقة بالمبيعات، وتقديم التوصيات والحلول المناسبة، وحفظها في قاعدة البيانات وفقاً للسياسات والإجراءات المعتمدة. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى 1 سنة في مجال المبيعات أو ما يعادله. القدرة على تحليل بيانات السوق وتحديد الفرص والتحديات. مهارات تواصل ممتازة للتفاعل مع العملاء والزملاء. بيئة العمل هذا الدور هو وظيفة بدوام كامل ضمن فريق الشركة في جدة، مكة المكرمة. ستعمل ضمن بيئة ديناميكية تركز على تحقيق الأهداف البيعية وتطوير استراتيجيات المبيعات. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذا المنصب سيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات، وسيتم الإفصاح عنه خلال عملية المقابلة.

dc62652cdc71d052.job_title: Senior Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE) for AI and GenAI Inference Optimization
dc62652cdc71d052.description: About the Role AMD is seeking a Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE) for AI and GenAI Inference Optimization to join the team in Riyadh. This full-time role involves working directly with strategic partners and customers to enable, optimize, and deploy state-of-the-art GenAI inference workloads on AMD data center CPUs and GPUs (Instinct™ family). The successful candidate will bridge the gap between cutting-edge AI models and AMD hardware, aiming to drive competitive performance across the full inference stack. This position requires 5-10 years of relevant experience. Key Responsibilities Partner with customers to enable and optimize large language models (LLMs) and multimodal models on AMD Instinct GPUs, meeting committed performance and accuracy targets. Optimize GenAI inference pipelines on vLLM and SGLang, including PD disaggregation, expert parallelism (EP/wide-EP), tensor/data parallelism, speculative decoding, and KV cache management. Develop and tune low-level GPU kernels (Triton, HIP, composable kernels) for attention, MoE, GEMM, quantization, and normalization operations. Profile end-to-end workloads, identify bottlenecks across GPU/CPU boundaries, and deliver measurable throughput and latency improvements against competitive targets. Enable advanced data types and techniques (FP8, MXFP4, sparse attention) with a focus on both performance and numerical accuracy. Debug complex runtime, stability, and accuracy issues in production environments; collaborate with core engineering teams to identify root causes and contribute fixes. Contribute optimizations back to open-source frameworks (vLLM, SGLang, ATOM, AITER) and internal libraries; document best practices and deliver production-ready artifacts to customers. Leverage AI-assisted coding tools and agentic workflows to accelerate development, debugging, optimization, and code review across the inference stack. Required Qualifications BS, MS, or PhD in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or a related field, along with 8+ years of relevant experience. Solid expertise in GPU architecture and performance optimization, including hands-on experience with AMD ROCm (or CUDA) and GPU kernel development. Strong proficiency in Python and C++, with experience developing and optimizing kernels using Triton, HIP, or CUDA. Experience with AI-assisted coding and agentic development tools (*, GitHub Copilot, Claude, Cursor, or equivalent) to enhance productivity in kernel development, large-scale codebase navigation, debugging, and framework integration. Experience working with LLM inference frameworks (vLLM, SGLang, or equivalent) and serving optimization techniques. Solid understanding of transformer and MoE architectures, quantization, and distributed inference strategies (TP, DP, EP, and related parallelism techniques). Proficiency with profiling and debugging tools (*, rocProfiler, ROCdebug-agent). Preferred Qualifications Experience optimizing frontier models (DeepSeek, Qwen, Kimi, MiniMax, GLM, etc.) in production environments. Track record of contributing to open-source AI inference frameworks. Experience integrating AI-driven automation into engineering workflows and developer tooling. Strong customer-facing communication skills and the ability to manage technical deliverables against committed timelines. Company Overview At AMD, technology is leveraged to address significant global challenges, from advancing healthcare and scientific discovery to powering AI and everyday technologies. Innovation at AMD contributes to shaping the future. Every role at AMD supports the development of technology that moves the world forward.

In its Resolution A/RES/72/279, the United Nations General Assembly endorsed the transformation of the Development Operations Coordination Office (DCO) as a stand-alone coordination office within the United Nations Secretariat. DCO exercises managerial and oversight functions of the resident coordinator system under the oversight of the Chair of the United Nations Sustainable Development Group (UNSDG). In 2026, DCO undertook a recalibration to ensure the RC system remains optimally configured to support the acceleration of the 2030 Agenda and embodies the UN 2.0 shift- anchored in data, digital, innovation, behavioral science, strategic foresight, and a mission driven organizational culture. dc44b78111e36428.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة ساس التقنيه للمقاولات عن مهندس الصحة والسلامة والبيئة للانضمام إلى فريقها في منطقة القصيم، وتحديداً في مدينتي راس تنورة والرس. يركز هذا الدور بدوام كامل على دراسة وتطوير معايير الصحة والسلامة والبيئة للمشاريع الهندسية، بالإضافة إلى مراقبة وتحليل عملية التنفيذ لضمان الامتثال التام. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية المساهمة في عملية التصميم الشاملة للمشاريع وتقديم المشورة المتخصصة بشأن المواد ومعايير الجودة البيئية. الإشراف المباشر على أعمال صيانة وإصلاح المعدات لتقليل العوادم والمخلفات، وضمان سير العمليات وفقاً لمعايير الصحة والسلامة والبيئة. مراقبة العمليات وإجراء جولات تفتيشية منتظمة لمواقع التشغيل والعمليات، والتأكد من اتباع معايير سلامة البيئة، وتقديم النصح والمشورة اللازمة في هذا الخصوص. تطوير أساليب وإجراءات العمل بشكل مستمر ومواكبة أحدث التطورات التقنية في المجال. إعداد الوثائق والتقارير المتخصصة المتعلقة بالأعمال والمشروعات الهندسية، وتوضيح نسب تقدمها، وعرضها، وحفظها في قاعدة البيانات المخصصة وفقاً للسياسات والإجراءات المعتمدة. المؤهلات والخبرات المطلوبة خبرة عملية تتراوح بين سنتين إلى خمس سنوات في مجال الصحة والسلامة والبيئة. فهم عميق لمعايير الصحة والسلامة والبيئة المتعلقة بالمشاريع الهندسية. القدرة على تحليل البيانات وتقديم توصيات فعالة. المهارات والكفاءات مهارات ممتازة في التواصل وتقديم المشورة. القدرة على تطوير الإجراءات ومواكبة التطورات التقنية. مهارات إعداد التقارير والتوثيق بدقة. الالتزام بمعايير الجودة والسلامة. بيئة العمل هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل وتتطلب التواجد في مواقع العمل ضمن منطقة القصيم، وتحديداً في مدينتي راس تنورة والرس. ستعمل ضمن فريق متخصص يهدف إلى تحقيق أعلى معايير الصحة والسلامة والبيئة في جميع المشاريع. تقديم الطلبات لم يتم الكشف عن تفاصيل الراتب لهذه الوظيفة. ندعو المهندسين المؤهلين والمهتمين للتقدم لهذه الفرصة.

dc4a34f49af684d5.description: About Fluor Corporation Fluor Corporation is committed to designing and building projects and careers. The company fosters a welcoming and collaborative work environment that encourages innovative solutions and big-picture thinking, aiming to contribute to building a better world. This role is based in Saudi Arabia and is a full-time position. Role Overview The Manager Material Management serves as a Project Purchasing Manager for small to medium-sized Engineering, Procurement, Fabrication, and Construction (EPFC) projects. Alternatively, this position may function as a regional manager for non-project procurement activities. The role involves overseeing material management from procurement through receipt at designated points of use. Key Responsibilities Serve as a project member in formulating plans and executing overall material management activities, or assist in planning and executing specialized Material Management activities (material control, procurement, expediting, logistics, inspection, or field material management) for projects or offices. Manage the procurement work process and report the material management status of purchased material and equipment from purchase through receipt at assigned points of use. Oversee the development of all purchasing and Material Management activities from requisition to close-out, including assigning requisitions and Request for Quotation or Proposal packages to appropriate procurement and other material management personnel. Implement, manage, and monitor the Material Management Work Process using the approved Corporate Reference Tool for Material Management to meet project requirements and schedules. Perform supervisory responsibilities as appropriate. Generate Request for Quotation (RFQ) and Purchase Orders (PO) in the approved material management reference system for project, estimate, or proposal work. Perform other duties as assigned. Qualifications and Experience A minimum of 10 years of experience in material management or a related field. Demonstrated experience in managing procurement processes for engineering, procurement, fabrication, and construction (EPFC) projects. Proficiency in material management work processes and corporate reference tools. Application Process Candidates interested in this full-time Manager Material Management position are invited to apply. Salary details will be disclosed during the recruitment process.

dc6fe5d36bd5f0ed.description: About KBR Saudi Arabia KBR Sustainable Technology Solutions (STS) delivers comprehensive solutions across the entire asset lifecycle. This includes licensed process technologies, advisory services, technical domain expertise, energy transition solutions, high-end design capabilities, and smart solutions for optimizing planned and operating assets. Role Overview KBR Saudi Arabia is seeking a Maintenance Manager (HDPE) for a full-time position in Al Jubail. This role involves overseeing all maintenance activities for the HDPE Plant, ensuring operational reliability and compliance with company standards. The ideal candidate will have over 10 years of experience in a relevant field. Key Responsibilities Execute all assigned maintenance jobs for mechanical, electrical, and instrumentation activities at the HDPE Plant, adhering to Company standards. Provide regular reports on maintenance execution within the CMMS system for the HDPE Plant. Offer necessary support to the Planning and Scheduling Supervisor. Support the Company Reliability Department with bad actor analysis and reliability improvement initiatives. Prepare weekly maintenance reports and present updates during maintenance meetings. Manage daily maintenance activities to ensure plant equipment availability and reliability. Coordinate preventive, predictive, and corrective maintenance for HDPE process equipment. Review and enhance personnel competency through job-specific training, in coordination with the Head of HR. Ensure strict compliance with all HSE requirements during maintenance execution. Support maintenance shutdowns, turnarounds, and major equipment overhauls to achieve safe and timely completion. Required Qualifications and Experience A minimum of 20 years of experience in maintenance management, preferably within an HDPE plant environment. Demonstrated ability to manage mechanical, electrical, and instrumentation maintenance activities. Proficiency in using CMMS systems for maintenance reporting and tracking. Strong understanding of reliability improvement initiatives and bad actor analysis. Experience in coordinating maintenance shutdowns, turnarounds, and equipment overhauls. Work Environment and Location This is a full-time position based in Al Jubail, Saudi Arabia. The role requires active involvement in plant operations and coordination with various departments to ensure continuous and reliable performance of the HDPE facility. Application Process Candidates who meet the specified requirements are encouraged to apply. Salary details will be discussed during the interview process.

dca60c2579997d26.description: About Jacobs Engineering Group Inc. Jacobs Engineering Group Inc. focuses on solving critical global problems across various sectors, including urban development, environmental resilience, and scientific discovery. The company aims to transform abstract ideas into realities that benefit the world. Role Overview Jacobs is seeking a Senior Engineer - Testing & Commissioning to join the team in Saudi Arabia. This full-time position is available across All SA Regions, specifically in Neom, Tabuk, and Riyadh. The role involves providing contractual leadership for a major program, focusing on electrical and ICT commissioning for water assets. Key Responsibilities Review testing, commissioning, and handover deliverables, including T&C plans, method statements, procedures, Inspection and Test Plans, test records, and O&M documentation, against contractual and technical requirements. Support the resolution of review comments by tracking outstanding items and following up with Contractors to ensure timely and compliant close-out. Identify gaps in Contractor submissions and assess their impact on testing, commissioning, handover, and operational readiness. Assess potential constraints and risks to achieving full contract-compliant testing and commissioning, providing practical and well-justified recommendations to address identified gaps. Review commissioning programs and sequencing, covering pre-commissioning, functional testing, performance testing, integrated systems testing, and trial operations. Witness or support the verification of key tests and commissioning activities as required, ensuring results are properly recorded and accepted. Support the preparation and review of punch lists, defect close-out, completion certificates, and acceptance documentation. Coordinate with Engineering, Construction, Operations & Maintenance, and Asset Management teams to ensure handover requirements and operational readiness needs are met. Support the transfer of as-built documentation, O&M manuals, spares, training records, and asset data to the receiving Operator. Provide technical input for engineering-related change requests, variations, non-conformances, and queries concerning testing and commissioning. Report on T&C and handover progress, outstanding issues, and risks to project leadership. Qualifications and Experience Minimum of 10 years of experience in testing, commissioning, and handover of major infrastructure, utilities, building, or industrial projects. Strong technical knowledge of commissioning processes across mechanical, electrical, ICT, and Instrumentation & Control systems, including integrated systems testing. Proven experience in reviewing Contractor T&C and handover deliverables against contract and technical requirements. Demonstrated ability to identify gaps, assess risks and constraints, and recommend practical solutions where full contract compliance may be challenging. Sound understanding of operational readiness, asset handover, completion, and acceptance processes. Knowledge of relevant international codes, standards, and commissioning guidelines (*, IEC, NFPA, ASHRAE, CIBSE). Experience on major programs or giga-projects in the GCC is preferred. Required Skills Good stakeholder management and coordination skills, with the ability to work effectively with Contractors, Engineering, Construction, and Operations teams. Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to prepare clear review comments, technical assessments, and reports. Proficiency in document management platforms (*, Aconex), commissioning management tools, and MS Office. Application Information This is a full-time position. Salary details will be discussed during the interview process.

dcab039779c38359.description: نبذة عن الدور يبحث مجمع بلسم علاج الطبي العام عن فني أشعة علاجية للانضمام إلى فريقه في الخرمة، مكة المكرمة. يتولى شاغل الوظيفة مسؤولية استخدام تقنيات الأشعة عالية الطاقة لعلاج الأورام السرطانية والسيطرة عليها وفقاً للوصفات الطبية الصادرة عن أخصائيي الرعاية الصحية. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية تحضير المرضى وشرح الإجراءات العلاجية لهم، وضبط وضع أجسامهم بالطريقة الصحيحة للعلاج الإشعاعي. مساعدة المرضى على فهم الآثار الجانبية المحتملة للعلاج الإشعاعي، وتطبيق أجهزة التثبيت والحماية والمتطلبات المشابهة. مراجعة الوصفات الطبية المقدمة من أخصائيي الرعاية الصحية لتحديد نوع العلاج المطلوب، ومعايرة الأجهزة وضبط وضعها بناءً على ذلك. توجيه الجرعات الإشعاعية الموصوفة إلى الأعضاء المستهدفة في الجسم، وإعطاء الجرعات العلاجية لعلاج النمو السرطاني. مراقبة أداء الأجهزة وحالة المريض بدقة أثناء العلاج، وإجراء التعديلات اللازمة على الأجهزة حسب الحاجة. مساعدة الأطباء في تقييم مدى فعالية العلاج وإعادة تقييم خطط العلاج عند الضرورة. المؤهلات والخبرات المطلوبة خبرة عملية تتراوح بين سنتين إلى خمس سنوات في مجال الأشعة العلاجية. القدرة على استخدام تقنية الأشعة عالية الطاقة بفعالية وأمان. فهم شامل للوصفات الطبية المتعلقة بالعلاج الإشعاعي. المهارات والكفاءات مهارات تواصل ممتازة لشرح الإجراءات للمرضى وتقديم الدعم لهم. دقة عالية في معايرة الأجهزة وضبطها. القدرة على مراقبة المرضى والاستجابة للتغيرات في حالتهم أثناء العلاج. العمل بفعالية ضمن فريق الرعاية الصحية. بيئة العمل هذا الدور هو وظيفة بدوام كامل في مجمع بلسم علاج الطبي العام بمدينة الخرمة، مكة المكرمة. يتطلب الدور التزاماً بالعمل ضمن بيئة طبية متخصصة تهدف إلى تقديم أفضل رعاية للمرضى. تقديم الطلبات نرحب بالمرشحين المؤهلين لتقديم طلباتهم لهذا الدور. سيتم تحديد الراتب بناءً على المؤهلات والخبرة بعد المقابلة.

dcc3f7d9766634c0.description: About the Role The Luxury Collection is seeking a Chief Engineer to manage all engineering and maintenance operations. This full-time position is based in Ad Diriyah, Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, and focuses on maintaining the building, grounds, and physical plant with an emphasis on safety, security, and asset protection. The role involves managing budgets, capital expenditure projects, preventative maintenance, and energy conservation, while ensuring compliance with regulatory requirements. Key Responsibilities Oversee engineering operations, including equipment, refrigeration, HVAC, plumbing, water treatment, electrical, and life safety systems. Ensure equipment operates at optimum effectiveness, efficiency, and safety. Establish and manage an effective rooms maintenance program. Manage departmental controllable expenses to achieve or exceed budgeted goals. Select, order, or purchase new equipment, supplies, and furnishings. Inspect and evaluate the physical condition of facilities to determine required work. Recommend or arrange for additional services such as painting, repair work, renovations, and equipment replacement. Maintain accurate logs and records as required. Assist in planning, scheduling, and evaluating preventative maintenance programs. Lead the emergency response team for all facility issues. Customer Service and Profitability Address guest problems and complaints effectively. Empower employees to deliver excellent customer service and foster a positive atmosphere for guest relations. Help establish priorities for total property maintenance needs. Ensure ongoing communication within all areas of responsibility to align with business objectives and recognize exemplary performance. Human Resources and Compliance Recognize and celebrate team member contributions. Establish and maintain open, collaborative relationships with employees, ensuring fair and equitable treatment. Provide feedback to employees based on service behavior observations and solicit employee feedback. Supervise employee execution of departmental and property emergency procedures. Review employee satisfaction results to identify and address concerns. Ensure regulatory compliance with facility regulations and safety standards. Ensure disciplinary procedures and documentation adhere to Standard and Local Operating Procedures (SOPs and LSOPs). Qualifications and Experience 5-10 years of relevant experience in engineering or maintenance operations. Demonstrated ability to manage budgets, capital expenditure projects, and preventative maintenance programs. Strong understanding of regulatory requirements and safety standards. Experience in leading emergency response teams. Work Environment This is a full-time position located in Ad Diriyah, Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. The role requires a proactive approach to maintaining property standards and a commitment to providing exceptional customer service within a dynamic hospitality environment.

dcd0cd2938d9d421.description: Rgheeb is seeking a highly motivated and experienced Operations Manager for our Specialty Coffee division. You will lead a team of professionals dedicated to delivering exceptional coffee experiences to our customers. The ideal candidate will have a strong background in operations management within the coffee or food and beverage industry, excellent leadership skills, and a passion for specialty coffee. Join Rgheeb and contribute to growing our brand and maintaining our reputation for excellence. Responsibilities 1. Operations Management Manage the daily functioning of all coffee outlets to guarantee seamless and efficient operation Uphold excellent standards in coffee quality, customer service, and cleanliness Ensure all locations follow SOPs, brand guidelines, and health & safety requirements Track workflow efficiency and introduce improvements where needed 2. Specialty Coffee Quality Control Maintain consistency in coffee preparation methods (espresso, manual brewing, specialty beverages) Ensure coffee equipment is properly calibrated and brewing standards are met Collaborate closely with Store Managers, Head Baristas, and Coffee Trainers on quality assessments Oversee proper sourcing, storage, and handling of coffee beans 3. Ability to analyze data and implement operational improvements. Strong communication and interpersonal skills. Experience managing multi-unit operations

dcd3de5ff0b9f7a2.description: About the Role Tractebel is seeking a Project Design Coordinator to work full-time on behalf of the Client. This role will be based in the Client's offices in Jeddah or Riyadh, Makkah, KSA. The coordinator will focus on thermal power generation project(s), overseeing design review coordination among the EPC Contractor, Project Owner's Consultant, and all Owner stakeholders, including HSE, Operations, IT, and Security. This position requires over 10 years of experience. Key Responsibilities Act as the primary point of contact between the CONSULTANT and project stakeholders, including the EPC contractor, design consultants, and regulatory bodies, for managing engineering deliverable reviews and approvals. Track the submission, review, and approval processes for all engineering deliverables, such as designs, drawings, specifications, and reports. Ensure timely dissemination of deliverables to relevant parties, keeping all stakeholders informed of status and schedules. Develop and maintain a detailed schedule for engineering deliverable reviews, approvals, and submissions. Coordinate with the CONSULTANT and EPC teams to align deliverables with project timelines and milestones. Monitor progress, identify potential delays, and collaborate with stakeholders to mitigate schedule risks. Organize regular meetings (weekly, bi-weekly, monthly) with the CONSULTANT, EPC contractor, and other stakeholders to review deliverable status and address issues. Prepare and distribute meeting agendas, minutes, action items, and follow up on resolutions to ensure effective communication. Develop and maintain communication channels to manage information flow among project participants. Ensure all engineering deliverables are reviewed and approved according to project quality standards and regulatory requirements. Maintain comprehensive records of submissions, approvals, revisions, and correspondences related to engineering deliverables. Assist in implementing quality control measures to verify the accuracy and completeness of deliverables. Identify potential risks related to deliverable review and approval, including delays, quality issues, and compliance concerns. Work with the CONSULTANT and project management team to develop and implement risk mitigation strategies. Maintain a risk register and track the resolution of issues related to engineering deliverables. Assist in managing changes to engineering deliverables, ensuring proper documentation, communication, and approval according to change management procedures. Track and report the impact of changes on project scope, schedule, and budget. Prepare regular progress reports on the status of engineering deliverables, highlighting achievements, issues, and upcoming milestones. Assist in preparing monthly project status reports for the project management team and senior stakeholders. Demonstrated experience in managing design review processes for thermal power generation projects. Proficiency in coordinating between multiple stakeholders, including EPC contractors, consultants, and owner teams. Work Environment This is a full-time position based in the Client's offices in Jeddah or Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. The role involves direct interaction with various project stakeholders and requires a collaborative approach to project execution.

dcdae93ed67ef98e.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة حرف لتقنية المعلومات عن مدير دعم فني تقنية معلومات للانضمام إلى فريقها في الرياض. يتولى شاغل هذا الدور قيادة الفريق التقني والإشراف على المهام المتعلقة بدعم الأنظمة القائمة وتطويرها، مع ضمان التوافق مع المتطلبات الفنية والأمنية. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية قيادة الفريق التقني وتوزيع مهام الإصلاح والتحسين على الأنظمة، وتحديد الأولويات بالتنسيق مع إدارة المشروع. تحويل المتطلبات المعتمدة إلى تصاميم وخطط تنفيذ فنية، ومراجعة توافقها مع البنية المؤسسية ومتطلبات الأمن والأداء. مراجعة الكود والتصاميم والتكاملات وتوجيه المطورين، ومعالجة التحديات الفنية المعقدة لضمان اتساق الحلول. تنظيم إدارة المستودعات ومراجعات الكود وخطوط البناء والاختبار والنشر باستخدام المنصات المعتمدة في المشروع. تنسيق جاهزية الإصدارات مع أقسام الجودة والأمن والتشغيل، والتحقق من اكتمال متطلبات التنفيذ والتراجع قبل توصية الإطلاق. مراجعة الوثائق الفنية ومتابعة تحديثها، وقيادة نقل المعرفة الفنية وتوثيق القرارات والممارسات المعتمدة. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة عملية تتراوح بين 5 إلى 10 سنوات في مجال الدعم الفني لتقنية المعلومات أو إدارة المشاريع التقنية. فهم عميق للبنية المؤسسية ومتطلبات الأمن والأداء في الأنظمة التقنية. القدرة على قيادة الفرق التقنية وتوجيه المطورين. بيئة العمل هذا الدور هو وظيفة بدوام كامل ومقرها في الرياض، المملكة العربية السعودية. ستعمل ضمن فريق متخصص في شركة حرف لتقنية المعلومات. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذا المنصب سيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات، ولن يتم الإفصاح عنه في هذه المرحلة.

dcd6a28fb36c1567.description: Job Purpose: The Facilities Manager will be responsible for overseeing daily operations and management of facilities, ensuring they are well-maintained, efficient, and meet customer needs. The ideal candidate will possess strong organizational and leadership skills, a comprehensive understanding of facilities management principles, and a customer-focused approach. Duties and Responsibilities: Manage daily operations of facilities, overseeing maintenance, repairs, and service requests. Ensure facilities are well-maintained, clean, and safe for users and visitors. Develop and implement preventive maintenance programs to reduce equipment failures, extend asset life, and minimize downtime. Coordinate and schedule maintenance and repair activities, ensuring timely and efficient completion. Manage vendor relationships and contracts for maintenance, repairs, and other facility-related services. Conduct regular inspections and audits of facilities to identify maintenance needs, safety hazards, and improvement opportunities. Respond promptly to emergencies and incidents related to the facility, ensuring swift resolution and minimal disruption to operations. Collaborate with clients to understand their facility needs and provide effective solutions. Develop and manage facility budgets, tracking expenses and ensuring cost-effective operations. Invoice clients monthly for contracted work, as well as additional services, and follow up on collections. Monitor and analyze facility performance metrics, identifying areas for improvement and implementing corrective actions. Ensure compliance with regulatory requirements, building codes, and safety standards in all facility operations. Implement and promote sustainable practices and energy-saving initiatives. Develop and maintain facility documentation, including maintenance records, operating procedures, and emergency response plans. Foster a positive and collaborative work environment, leading and motivating facilities management teams. Provide regular reports and updates to senior management on facility management activities, performance, and key metrics. Stay informed about the latest industry trends, best practices, and developments in facilities management technologies. Maintain a strong focus on customer service, addressing client inquiries and concerns professionally and promptly. Adhere to company policies and procedures, including health and safety guidelines. Required Qualifications and Experience: Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Facilities Management, Business Administration, or a related field. Relevant certifications or a combination of education and experience will also be considered. Proven experience in facilities management, preferably in a service-oriented company. Strong knowledge of facilities management principles, practices, and standards. Excellent organizational and time management skills, with the ability to multitask and prioritize effectively.
